infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Handheld uses your microphone for live two-way voice conversation with your Boson AI tour guide.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Handheld uses your location to prefetch nearby landmarks and guide your walking tour.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Handheld uses AirPods head motion to know which building or facade you are looking at.
